confidence.description: Heuristic HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW label; not a calibrated correctness probability.

conflict.description: A limited rule-based conflict flag; false does not establish truth.

conflict_type.description: Optional attribute or relation conflict category.

conflict_with.description: Optional edge ID(s) involved in the conflict.

first_seen.description: Earliest supporting SEC claim publication date; not relation validity start.

group_type.description: Fusion bookkeeping classification; see group definitions below.

last_seen.description: Latest supporting SEC claim publication date; not relation validity end.

layer.description: core/extended export classification; extended is not a correctness judgement.

relation.description: Predicate; direction is described in the relation table.

source_count.description: Number of distinct supporting documents; not the number of source families.

source_types.description: Supporting source families: SEC and/or WIKIPEDIA.

sources.description: Unique supporting document_id values, not URLs.
